A [[human]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> [[Guavian Death Gang]] '''soldier''' visited the [[supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' with their [[Unidentified Guavian security soldier 2|partner]]<ref name="The Platform Classic" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="TPC Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|9}}</ref> While aboard, the pair took the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Oplock]] hostage, eventually releasing him only when his employer, the [[racer]] [[Marcus Speedstar]], paid his debts to the Guavians.<ref name="The Platform Classic" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The soldier first appeared in "[[The Platform Classic]],"<ref name="The Platform Classic" /> the ninth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[November 25]], [[2018]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
